defs.d: (crosswords, often in combination) A word that runs horizontally in the completed puzzle grid or its associated clue.
defs.ex: I solved all of the acrosses, but then got stuck on 3 down.

defs.d: From one side to the other.
defs.ex: she helped the blind man across;  the river is half a mile across

defs.d: On the other side.
defs.ex: If we sail off at noon, when will we be across?

defs.d: To, toward or from the far side of (something that lies between two points of interest).
defs.ex: Fortunately, there was a bridge across the river.

defs.d: On the opposite side of (something that lies between two points of interest).
defs.ex: That store is across the street.

defs.d: The quality of being different.
defs.ex: You need to learn to be more tolerant of difference.

defs.d: A characteristic of something that makes it different from something else.
defs.ex: There are three differences between these two pictures.

defs.d: To distinguish or differentiate.
The act of examining.
Particularly, an inspection by a medical professional to establish the extent and nature of any sickness or injury.
To observe or inspect carefully or critically
defs.ex: He examined the crime scene for clues.

defs.d: To check the health or condition of something or someone
defs.ex: The doctor examined the patient.

defs.d: To make famous; to bring renown to.
Well known.
In the public eye.
defs.ex: Some people are only famous within their city.

defs.d: A person between 13 and 19 years of age; an adolescent.
Something that would happen, or would be the case, under different circumstances; a potentiality.
Any condition, circumstance, opportunity or means, particularly favorable to success, or to any desired end.
defs.ex: The enemy had the advantage of a more elevated position.

defs.d: Superiority; mastery; — used with of to specify its nature or with over to specify the other party.
To provide (someone) with an advantage, to give an edge to
To do something for one's own benefit; to take advantage of
The amount of space between two points, usually geographical points, usually (but not necessarily) measured along a straight line.
defs.ex: From Moscow, the distance is relatively short to Saint Petersburg, relatively long to Novosibirsk, but even greater to Vladivostok.

defs.d: Length or interval of time.
To move away (from) someone or something.
defs.ex: He distanced himself from the comments made by some of his colleagues.

defs.d: To leave at a distance; to outpace, leave behind.
To enter into the conjugal or connubial state; to take a husband or a wife.
defs.ex: Neither of her daughters showed any desire to marry.

defs.d: (in passive) To be joined to (someone) as spouse according to law or custom.
defs.ex: His daughter was married some five years ago to a tailor's apprentice.

defs.d: A prediction.
To make a prediction: to forecast, foretell, or estimate a future event on the basis of knowledge and reasoning; to prophesy a future event on the basis of mystical knowledge or power.
(of theories, laws, etc.) To imply.
One who speaks.
Loudspeaker.
An act of announcing, or giving notice.
defs.ex: He raised his hand to make his announcement and said "Excuse me everyone, I have an announcement to make.

defs.d: That which conveys what is announced.
defs.ex: This announcement was made during the first training session.

defs.d: A shaking of the ground, caused by volcanic activity or movement around geologic faults.
(planetary geology) Such a quake specifically occurring on the planet Earth, as opposed to other celestial bodies.
The emotion of being happy; joy.
Prosperity, thriving, wellbeing.
A film, TV program, publication etc. which presents a social, political, scientific or historical subject in a factual or informative manner.
Of, related to, or based on documents.
Which serves to document (record and:or illustrate) a subject.
Anything shiny; a trinket.
Contraction of disparaging term "shiny arses", originating during World War Two, to describe a desk worker.https//books.google.co.uk/books?id=mAdUqLrKw4YC&pg=PA1717
Reflecting light.
Emitting light.
Encoded computer instructions, usually modifiable (unless stored in some form of unalterable memory such as ROM).
The human beings involved in warfare, as opposed to hardware such as weapons and vehicles.
The act of retiring, or the state of being retired.
A place to which one retires.
To stop working on a permanent basis, usually because of old age or illness.
defs.ex: Having made a large fortune, he retired.

defs.d: (sometimes reflexive) To withdraw; to take away.
To produce one or more copies of a text or image on a surface, especially by machine; often used with out or off: print out, print off.
defs.ex: Print the draft double-spaced so we can mark changes between the lines.

defs.d: To produce a microchip (an integrated circuit) in a process resembling the printing of an image.
defs.ex: The circuitry is printed onto the semiconductor surface.

defs.d: The process or business of producing printed material by means of inked type and a printing press or similar technology.
Material that has been printed.
A pickup truck with a gun mounted on it.
A technical foul: a violation of sportsmanlike conduct, not involving physical contact.

Of or pertaining to the useful or mechanic arts, or to any academic, legal, science, engineering, business, or the like terminology with specific and precise meaning or (frequently, as a degree of distinction) shades of meaning; specially appropriate to any art, science or engineering field, or business
(of a person) Technically-minded; adept with science and technology.
(Old English law) To make a tender of; to offer or tender.
(followed by a to-infinitive) To be likely, or probable to do something, or to have a certain habit or leaning.
defs.ex: It tends to snow here in winter.

defs.d: (of a proposition) to have as a necessary consequence
defs.ex: The proposition that "all dogs are mammals" implies that my dog is a mammal

defs.d: (of a person) to suggest by logical inference
defs.ex: When I state that your dog is brown, I am not implying that all dogs are brown

defs.d: Armed forces.
defs.ex: He spent six years in the military.

defs.d: Characteristic of members of the armed forces.
defs.ex: She was dishonorably discharged from all military duties.

defs.d: Relating to armed forces such as the army, marines, navy and air force (often as distinguished from civilians or police forces).
defs.ex: If you join a military force, you may end up killing people.

defs.d: Something that is flexible.
Capable of being flexed or bent without breaking; able to be turned or twisted without breaking.
Willing or prone to give way to the influence of others; not invincibly rigid or obstinate.
A portion of land or territory which the eye can comprehend in a single view, including all the objects it contains.
A sociological aspect of a physical area.
To create or maintain a landscape.
The act of slighting; a deliberate act of neglect or discourtesy.
Sleight.
To treat as unimportant or not worthy of attention; to make light of.
To give lesser weight or importance to.
Small
Of slender build
defs.ex: a slight but graceful woman

defs.d: What somebody is known for.
